title: E7 relevance audit checkpoint form B
instructions: Continue developing the seed-exchange paragraph. Select evidence that fulfils the paragraph promise and preserve the limits of the original notes.

parts.prompt: Which TWO details are relevant enough to keep?

options.text: Visitors began matching familiar packets to the labelled tables without first asking a volunteer.
Questions continued when a packet used a local name not shown on the label.
One tablecloth had a narrow green border.
A window faced the afternoon sun.
Every visitor became a successful gardener after the event.

choice_rationales.A: This supplies an observable benefit of the labels.
choice_rationales.B: This identifies the precise limit that should qualify the paragraph's claim.
choice_rationales.C: The border is decorative rather than explanatory.
choice_rationales.D: The window does not affect the sorting process.
choice_rationales.E: The notes contain no evidence about visitors' later gardening success.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: The two selected observations let the paragraph explain both what improved and what still required revision.

parts.prompt: Which development route is ready to draft?

options.text: Focused promise → category-and-month label method → independent sorting observation → local-name exception → cautious recommendation to add examples.
History of gardening → room decoration → claim that the trial was perfect.
List of seed colours → unrelated story about school → invented approval percentage.
Absolute claim that labels fail → repeat the claim → introduce a new event in the conclusion.

choice_rationales.A: This route moves from a bounded claim through method and evidence to a proportionate improvement.
choice_rationales.B: The setting details do not develop the trial and the final claim is unsupported.
choice_rationales.C: The route is irrelevant, incoherent and falsely precise.
choice_rationales.D: The absolute claim ignores mixed evidence and the ending introduces unrelated material.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: A draft-ready paragraph connects a focused assertion to relevant observation, significance and an evidence-based limit.
